title: US Intelligence Memo Alleges Chinese Espionage Targeting Nvidia CEO
excerpt: A leaked US intelligence memo claims a female technology executive was recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia's chief executive.
body_html: An intelligence memo circulated earlier this year states that a female technology executive was recruited by China's Ministry of State Security. According to the document, the individual's mission was to spy on the chief executive officer of Nvidia.
